title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 117
paragraphs: The Sauromatai use the Scythian tongue, but have spoken it barbarously from the very first, since the Amazons did not learn it thoroughly well. As regards marriages, their rule is this: no maiden may marry until she has killed a man of the enemy; and some of them even grow old and die unmarried, because they cannot fulfil the requirement of the law.
